title: NT-proBNP (heart strain test)
what: This is a blood test from a vein. It shows whether your heart is under strain.
why: For shortness of breath, swollen legs, getting tired fast, or to check heart failure treatment.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come the same or the next day
tell_doctor: What heart and blood pressure medicines you take
If shortness of breath is new or getting worse

prepare.title: Prep
prepare.text: Nothing special. Best in the morning, before a big breakfast. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Before the draw
prepare.text: No hard exercise. Sit quietly for 10 to 15 minutes.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything should change.

bring: Past NT-proBNP results and ECGs, if you have them
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood fills a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes and keep your arm straight
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
Results usually come in 1 day. The lab will tell you when
Your doctor compares the result with past ones. The trend matters
red_flags: Shortness of breath suddenly gets worse, you cannot lie flat, or you have chest pain: call emergency services
Swelling and weight go up fast over a few days: see a doctor soon

faq.q: Does a high NT-proBNP mean heart failure?
faq.a: Not necessarily. It depends on age, kidneys, and other things. Your doctor draws the conclusions.

reminders.text: NT-proBNP test tomorrow. Come in the morning before breakfast and avoid exercise.
